review.scope: One deployment-local release catalog; no organization/project column. Project namespace and publisher credential provisioning remain external authorities.

permissions.meaning: Raw {status:success,id:UUID}, no message/data envelope. Header Bearer must exactly match configured APK_PUBLISH_TOKEN≥32bytes; missing/short config503, wrong/missing credential401. User roles are not publisher credentials.

filters.meaning: JSON camelCase serviceSlug/appName/version/versionCode/downloadUrl. Slug1–100 ASCII letters/digits/hyphen; version1–40 ASCII letters/digits/dot/hyphen/underscore; nonblank appName≤80chars; positive i64 code; HTTPS URL without credentials. Invalid metadata400.

inputs_outputs.meaning: Raw {status:success,id:UUID}, no message/data envelope. Header Bearer must exactly match configured APK_PUBLISH_TOKEN≥32bytes; missing/short config503, wrong/missing credential401. User roles are not publisher credentials.

lifecycle.meaning: Transaction-scoped per-slug advisory lock serializes first insertion/upsert. Stable UUIDv5 identities unless existing matching records retain IDs. Older same-version numeric code is no-op; equal code can replace metadata; different version strings retain separate history. Preserve created_at, update modified_at, activate release, but do not rename/reactivate existing parent. Storage failure500 and atomic rollback; startup seeds preserve existing records.
